frame_time_mapping: Each output frame represents a 1/30 s video interval; its midpoint samples the corresponding recorded simulation time at 5x.
longitudinal_display: Linear 1:1 metre scale; the simulation's configured 100 m gap limit is explicitly labeled when reached. No renderer gap cap is applied.
playback_rate: 5x; each 10 s scene resamples its full 0–50 s recorded episode
